what_happened.line: The school building committee and its architect presented the preliminary design, schedule and reasons for a new 6-12 school on the football fields; the board took no vote on it.
The committee said the project goes to a fall town meeting in December or January, then to a ballot vote.
Costs the state would not reimburse came up: off-site work such as roads, and an indoor track, which would fall to the town.
The board approved the August 12 minutes as amended, then heard committee reports and the planning director's report.
The hazard mitigation plan update was put on the September 9 agenda, and the board adjourned to that date.

why_it_matters: A new Middle High School would be paid for partly by state reimbursement and partly by the town, and items the state does not reimburse, such as off-site road work and an indoor track, would add to the town's share and so to tax bills.
Residents will be asked to vote on the project at a town meeting and then at the ballot.
watch_next: Planning Board meeting on September 9, with the hazard mitigation plan update on the agenda.
The fall town meeting vote on the building project, expected in December or January, followed by a ballot vote.
